title: SEARCH-REPLAY: reporting ambiguity and uncertainty in published systematic searches
question: How often are published searches reconstructable, and how much retrieval and downstream variation is attributable to missing or ambiguous reporting?
design: Cross-sectional stratified metaresearch with blinded reconstruction, bounded multiverse analysis and an embedded remediation experiment.
unit_of_analysis: Published report as primary unit; searches, interpretations and repeated runs nested within report.
population_and_sampling: Pilot 24 reports (8 biomedical, 8 social/environmental, 8 bibliometric/scientometric). Proposed confirmation: 150 reports, 50 per stratum, sampled from frozen documented frames. Pilot reports cannot enter confirmation. Audit all reported database searches; do not replace reports because supplements or licences are unavailable.
primary_estimand: Proportion of sampled reports for which reconstructability of every declared database search can be established from available public reporting without undocumented methodological assumptions. Separately report inaccessible and non-assessable cases and identification bounds; do not infer poor reporting from inaccessible text.
secondary_outcomes: Coverage of six prespecified reporting prerequisites
Known-study retention where a reference set exists
precision_or_power: At n=150, simple independent Bernoulli sampling near p=.5 has approximately 8 percentage-point 95% half-width; stratified/design effects and nonresponse require appropriate recalculation before freeze. This is a precision rationale, not power for superiority.
analysis_plan: Use report-level stratified estimates and cluster bootstrap for nested retrieval outcomes. Main pooled estimand is an explicitly equal-weight three-stratum mixture, not all scholarship. Describe interpretation envelopes; estimate variance components only where the crossed design identifies them.
uncertainty_policy: Keep reporting/interpretation ambiguity, technical errors, index drift, access differences and analyst/model randomness distinct. An interpretation envelope is not a frequentist confidence interval. Historical drift is not identifiable without historical records/snapshots.
independence_and_blinding: Two independent reconstruction passes blinded to each other and initially to reported hit counts; adjudication preserves both first passes. Expert independent assessors are required before claiming human reconstruction agreement.
reproducibility: Pin protocol, sampling manifest, raw observations, CSL-JSON corpus, sidecars, code, dependencies, environment, model/configuration and output digests. Use DVC for file-stage orchestration and Workflow Run RO-Crate for portable provenance; a fresh live acquisition is a new observation.
ethics_and_rights: Determine institutional review requirements before recruiting evaluators or contacting authors. Preserve source-specific licences. Public access is not blanket redistribution or model-training permission. Report reporting limitations, not allegations of research misconduct.
unresolved_execution_gates: Owner approval and freeze of the study-specific protocol before confirmatory data access.
Rights and access qualification for each source/dataset.
Pilot-driven precision/power decision and frozen sampling frame where applicable.
Required independent evaluators/assessors available; internal agent passes are not substituted.
amendment_policy: Append a versioned amendment with rationale, actor, timing relative to data access, affected estimands and downstream invalidation. Never silently overwrite the frozen protocol or change a confirmatory endpoint after seeing its result.
